subject: Setting wave player in R profile

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Setting wave player in R profile
parts:
I'm trying to set my wave player as "afplay" in my R profile file. In my R profile file, I have this line:

library(tuneR); setWavPlayer("afplay")


When I start up R, one of the messages I get is:

tuneR >= 1.0 has changed its Wave class definition.
Use updateWave(object) to convert Wave objects saved with previous versions of tuneR.

So the tuneR package is loading. But when I try to use listen, like this:

library(seewave); data(tico); listen(tico)

I get this:

/bin/sh: /var/folders/5v/mwpxjb1n6qzfqp9l9t99bbl80000gn/T//Rtmp9qosDH/tuneRtemp.wav: Permission denied

Then if I run 

setWavPlayer("afplay")

in R, I can listen to tico fine. How can I set wave player as afplay in my R profile file?

messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Setting wave player in R profile
parts:
Hi Ross,

Weird that this doesn't work for you. I have no problems with my very similar setup.

I have:

require('tuneR')
setWavPlayer("play")  # the SoX play command

Here's a stab at it: I wonder if you might have multiple versions of .RProfile? E.g. if you have an RProfile in your home directory as well as one in the directory where you're invoking R, I'm not sure what the behavior is. You might try adding something like 

print("I have set the wav player")

at the end of your file to make sure you're editing the right file.

best,
jesse

library(seewave)
library(tuneR)
setWavPlayer("afplay")

seewave "imports" through a NAMESPACE the packages fftw and tuneR. I am not what this can imply in terms of priority but this may explain some things...
